About me

Let me tell you a little about myself.

I've been messing around with computers since I was a kid.

At first, I was simply curious.
I wanted to know how things worked, why things broke, and eventually how I could build things myself.

That curiosity never really left. It just found better tools.
These days it shows up as code, as animation, as little experiments I probably don't need to finish but do anyway.
